events.text: A landslide after the rains has torn a gully open in a nameless hillside. In the wet rock something glows, faintly, the way a lamp glows behind paper. You pick at it with your knife. It is a spirit stone, and behind it the whole hill is full of them: a natural vein, as thick as a river, running into the dark.

choices.text: Stake the claim and open a mine

effects.log: You drive your stakes, hire diggers and hang your seal on the gully. Within the season the first cart of spirit stones rolls out.

choices.text: Sell the secret of the place to a sect

effects.log: A sect elder pays you in silver for a map and your silence. You do not go back to the hillside, and neither, you hope, does anyone who saw you leave.

choices.text: Cover it over and walk away

effects.log: You pile the rocks back over the glow and walk away. A vein that big has killed more people than any blade.
